rows.reason: Two of the three official documents this family names cannot be filled, so an official_pdf_fill packet cannot be built from them and no form may be substituted. (1) The OCA Instructions and Model Letter for an Order of Nondisclosure under Section 411.072 — the recovery letter, component 2, the only instrument that makes this a fill family — is ENCRYPTED AND UNREADABLE. pdf-lib fails to open it with "Expected instance of PDFDict, but got instance of undefined" under every load option tried (ignoreEncryption, throwOnInvalidObject:false, parseSpeed 1000); the failure was reproduced first-hand here and matches the committed corpus index, which records structuralClassObserved "unreadable", encrypted true and that exact loadError for the same sha256. Nothing can open it, so neither the AcroForm path nor the flat-anchor path can render it. (2) The OCA Model Order of Nondisclosure under Section 411.072 — component 3 — is a FLAT PDF: acroFormPresent false, acroFieldCount 0 over 3 pages in the committed index, confirmed first-hand by loading the pinned bytes and finding zero AcroForm fields. There is no widget to write the participant's name into. Only component 4, the Statement of Inability, is fillable. Building the two guidance components and the fee-waiver Statement alone and dispositioning the letter and the order would ship something that is not the family MASTER_QUEUE names and would leave requiredComponentsMissing unclearable except by lowering the bar, so the row stops instead.
